comment: LocalChimera OCapN gateway entry points for the deployed static site. discoveryUrl names the gateway's own serve-static /entry-points.json — generated per request from the live gateway-sref.txt — so the page always learns the RUNNING gateway's sref (it changes on every restart: a swiss num dies with its process). sref/directWs below are the last-known fallback used only when the discovery host is unreachable.
